description: This file contains miscellaneous network utility functions for Zephyr OS, including address formatting, protocol string conversion, IP address parsing, checksum calculations, and address constants.

methods.name: net_sprint_addr
methods.description: Converts an IP address to a string representation based on address family.

methods.name: net_proto2str
methods.description: Returns a string description of a protocol given its family and protocol number.

methods.name: net_byte_to_hex
methods.description: Converts a byte to its hexadecimal string representation.

methods.name: net_sprint_ll_addr_buf
methods.description: Formats a link-layer address buffer into a human-readable string.

methods.name: z_impl_net_addr_ntop
methods.description: Converts a network address from binary to presentation format.

methods.name: z_impl_net_addr_pton
methods.description: Parses a string IP address into binary form.

methods.name: net_ipaddr_parse
methods.description: Parses a string IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) into a sockaddr structure.
